extraction_notes: BBAI 10-K (FY2023) is unusually generic about Pentagon programs — uses 'DoD/IC/DHS/Army programs/Air Force programs' language without naming specific Program Elements or PE numbers. The only named program in pre-cutoff filings is 'Air Force EPASS' (Engineering, Professional and Administrative Support Services), mentioned in 10-Q only as 'wound down in Q2 2023'. Customer concentration is anonymized as Customer A/B/C. This non-disclosure-of-program-names is itself a J-Book-pattern signal: the framework cannot map narrative revenue to specific PEs because the issuer hasn't named them.
